national.headline: President and PM agree to resolve political issues via talks
national.line: President Asif Ali Zardari and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif agreed to resolve all political matters through dialogue amid rising political tensions.

national.headline: Constitutional court sets aside high court rulings on infrastructure cess
national.line: The Federal Constitutional Court overturned high court verdicts that had upheld provincial infrastructure cess imposed by Sindh and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

national.headline: Advisory agreement signed for outsourcing Karachi and Lahore airports
national.line: The Privatisation Commission signed an agreement with an Ernst & Young-led consortium to advise on outsourcing operations at Karachi and Lahore airports.

national.headline: Lahore designated ECO Tourism Capital for 2027
national.line: Lahore formally assumed the title of ECO Tourism Capital for 2027, promoting Punjab’s cultural heritage and regional tourism cooperation.

national.headline: Pakistan tells UN India's water treaty suspension violates law
national.line: Pakistan told the UN that India's unilateral move to suspend the Indus Waters Treaty violates international law and threatens water security.

national.headline: SECP lowers borrowing cost caps on digital nano-loans
national.line: The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan sharply reduced maximum annual interest rates on digital nano-loans to protect borrowers.

international.headline: US, China, and Russia sign joint peace declaration
international.line: Leaders of the US, China, and Russia issued a joint statement seeking to reform the UN and limit the International Criminal Court.

international.headline: COP31 draft agreement drops mention of fossil fuels
international.line: Climate negotiators at COP31 in Turkiye published a revised draft agreement that excluded any commitment to phase out fossil fuels.

international.headline: Pakistan and 14 states back sanctions on Israeli settlements
international.line: Pakistan and 14 other countries endorsed British and Australian sanctions against Israeli settlement activities in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

international.headline: Denmark ratifies Greenland agreement with Trump
international.line: Denmark ratified a deal with Donald Trump concerning Greenland in an effort to end tensions between the two nations.

international.headline: ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
international.line: The International Court of Justice ruled that atrocities committed by Myanmar's military against Rohingya Muslims in 2017 amounted to state-sponsored genocide.

international.headline: Islam projected to be largest religion by mid-2030s
international.line: The Pew Research Centre projected that Islam will overtake Christianity as the world's most populous religion by the middle of next decade.
